title: Mixed finite elements and Stokes stability

items.title: Stokes velocity and pressure spaces and weak forms
items.statement: For a bounded connected Lipschitz domain D in R^d, d in {2,3}, define the real spaces V=H^1_0(D;R^d), Q=L^2_0(D), the gradient norm on V, the L2 norm on Q, epsilon(v), b(v,q)=-int_D q div v, and a_nu(u,v)=2 nu int_D epsilon(u):epsilon(v), nu>0. Distinguish the continuous domain class from the polygonal/polyhedral mesh subclass used by the mini element.
items.strategy: Give the typed definition and all conventions; prove any claimed well-definedness locally.

items.title: Zero mean of the divergence of a zero-boundary field
items.statement: For every bounded open D and v in H^1_0(D;R^d), div v is in L2(D) and has integral zero.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: A bounded-domain Poincare inequality for H1-zero fields
items.statement: If D is bounded and lies in a slab of width L in one coordinate direction, every scalar component v in H^1_0(D) satisfies ||v||_2 <= L ||grad v||_2.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: The homogeneous Dirichlet strain identity
items.statement: For v in H^1_0(D;R^d), 2||epsilon(v)||_2^2=||grad v||_2^2+||div v||_2^2, hence ||grad v||_2<=sqrt(2)||epsilon(v)||_2.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Finite star-shaped cover of a bounded Lipschitz domain
items.statement: A bounded connected Lipschitz domain D in R^d has a finite open cover D=union_i U_i with each U_i bounded, contained in D and star-shaped with respect to an interior ball; the intersection graph is connected. Record a measurable partition subordinate to the cover and normalized smooth bumps on a spanning-tree set of overlaps.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Zero-mean L2 decomposition over a finite cover
items.statement: Given the finite cover and its tree bumps, every q in L2_0(D) decomposes linearly as q=sum_i q_i, where q_i in L2_0(U_i), with explicit finite bounds ||q_i||_2<=C_i||q||_2.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: The Bogovskii integral on a star-shaped set
items.statement: For a bounded open U star-shaped with respect to an interior ball and a smooth unit-mass bump omega supported in that ball, define B_U f(x)=int_U f(y)(x-y) int_0^1 omega(y+(x-y)/t) dt/t^(d+1) dy for smooth compactly supported f; use its zero extension and the stated real Fourier convention.
items.strategy: Give the typed definition and all conventions; prove any claimed well-definedness locally.

items.title: Support, integrability, and divergence identity for the Bogovskii kernel
items.statement: For smooth compactly supported f, the Bogovskii formula defines an L2 vector field supported in a compact subset of U and div B_U f=f-omega int_U f distributionally. In particular div B_U f=f when f has mean zero.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Truncated Fourier formula for derivatives of the Bogovskii operator
items.statement: For smooth compactly supported data and phi in C_c^infinity, define the truncated distributional operator T_phi,j and prove its limit and the identity hat(T^<_{phi,j} f)(xi)=2 pi i xi_j int_0^(1/2) hat(phi)(t xi) hat(f)((1-t)xi) dt.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Elementary Fourier ray and derivative L2 bounds
items.statement: For phi in C_c^infinity and each coordinate j, prove the ray bound 2 pi |xi_j| int_0^infinity |hat(phi)(t xi)|dt <= rho^-1||phi||_1+rho||partial_j^2 phi||_1 and deduce the corresponding L2 bound for T_phi,j with its bounded-kernel tail.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Bounded Bogovskii right inverse on a star-shaped domain
items.statement: For bounded U star-shaped with respect to an interior ball, construct a bounded linear map B_U:L2_0(U)->H1_0(U;R^d) with div B_U f=f and ||grad B_U f||_2<=C_U||f||_2; state the explicit constant from the coordinate derivative bounds.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Divergence right inverse on bounded connected Lipschitz domains
items.statement: For every bounded nonempty connected Lipschitz D in R^d, d=2,3, construct a bounded linear B_D:L2_0(D)->H1_0(D;R^d) with div B_D q=q and ||grad B_Dq||_2<=C_div(D)||q||_2, where the explicit finite constant depends on the chosen cover but not on a finite-element mesh.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Hilbert inf-sup gives a bounded constraint right inverse
items.statement: For real Hilbert spaces V,Q and bounded b(v,q)=(Bv,q)_Q, if inf_{q!=0} sup_{v!=0} b(v,q)/(||v||||q||)>=beta>0, then B:V->Q is onto and has a linear right inverse R with ||R||<=beta^-1.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Continuous Stokes divergence inf-sup on a Lipschitz domain
items.statement: For V=H1_0(D;R^d) with gradient norm and Q=L2_0(D), b(v,q)=-int q div v is bounded by sqrt(d), and its inf-sup constant is at least C_div(D)^-1.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Fortin operator for a discrete constraint
items.statement: For conforming finite-dimensional V_h subset V and Q_h subset Q, define a Fortin operator as a bounded linear Pi_h:V->V_h satisfying b(Pi_h v,q_h)=b(v,q_h) for every v and q_h.
items.strategy: Give the typed definition and all conventions; prove any claimed well-definedness locally.

items.title: Fortin operators transfer the continuous inf-sup bound
items.statement: If the continuous inf-sup constant is beta and a Fortin operator has ||Pi_h||<=C_F, then the discrete inf-sup constant beta_h is at least beta/C_F.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Babuska-Brezzi solvability by kernel coercivity and inf-sup
items.statement: For real Hilbert V,Q, bounded a and b, coercivity of a on ker B, and inf-sup beta>0, prove unique solvability and stability of a(u,v)+b(v,p)=F(v), b(u,q)=G(q), including pressure uniqueness in the declared Q gauge.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Mixed Galerkin error bound retaining beta_h
items.statement: For conforming V_h,Q_h with discrete inf-sup beta_h>0, prove solvability and a mixed best-approximation bound with explicit constants depending on coercivity, continuity and beta_h; do not hide beta_h in a generic constant.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Boundary-preserving face-average P1 interpolation
items.statement: On a conforming shape-regular simplicial mesh of a bounded polyhedral domain, define a continuous P1 face-average quasi-interpolant without point evaluation. Prove H1 stability, L2 error O(h)|v|H1, and H1 error O(h)|v|H2 for H2 functions, including zero-boundary preservation and boundary patches.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: The conforming P1-bubble/P1 mini element
items.statement: For d=2,3 and a connected conforming shape-regular affine simplicial mesh of a polygon/polyhedron D, define V_h as continuous P1 vector fields with zero trace enriched by one interior scalar simplex bubble per component and cell, and Q_h as continuous P1 scalar functions with zero mean.
items.strategy: Give the typed definition and all conventions; prove any claimed well-definedness locally.

items.title: Local and global dimensions of the mini element
items.statement: On a d-simplex the local mini velocity dimension is d(d+2) and local pressure dimension d+1; globally dim V_h=d N_int+d N_K and dim Q_h=N_vertex-1 for a connected mesh.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Uniform Fortin stability of the mini element
items.statement: Construct the boundary-preserving Scott-Zhang plus cell-bubble mean correction Fortin map for the mini element. Prove exact preservation of b against continuous P1 pressure, uniform V-bound, and beta_h>=1/(C_F C_div(D)) independently of mesh size.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Weak and pointwise divergence-free discrete velocities
items.statement: Define the discrete weak constraint kernel Z_h={v_h:b(v_h,q_h)=0 for all q_h in Q_h} and the exact kernel Z_h^0={v_h:div v_h=0 a.e.}; prove the inclusion Z_h^0 subset Z_h from the stated pairings.
items.strategy: Give the typed definition and all conventions; prove any claimed well-definedness locally.

items.title: Mini-element H1 velocity and L2 pressure error estimate
items.statement: For a weak Stokes solution with u in H2(D)^d intersect H1_0(D)^d and p in H1(D) intersect L2_0(D), prove the mini-element bound ||u-u_h||H1+||p-p_h||2<=C h (||u||H2+||p||H1), with beta_h and viscosity dependence explicit and mesh-independent for a shape-regular family.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Discrete Helmholtz projection and pressure Schur identities
items.statement: In the finite mini-element spaces, prove the mass-orthogonal projector onto ker B_h is P_M=I-M^-1 B^T(BM^-1B^T)^-1B, and prove the mass and stiffness pressure Schur matrices are positive definite on mean-zero pressures; explain the constant-pressure null mode before gauge fixing.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: Weak Stokes solvability on bounded connected Lipschitz domains
items.statement: For nu>0 and F in V prime on a bounded connected Lipschitz D, prove a unique (u,p) in H1_0(D;R^d) x L2_0(D) satisfying the weak Stokes equations with b(v,p)=-int p div v and b(u,q)=0, and give a stability bound.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

title: Mixed finite elements and Stokes stability — Examples

items.title: A mini-element bubble detects an affine pressure gradient
items.statement: On a simplex K, for a nonconstant affine pressure q and bubble velocity b_K grad q, compute b_K(v,q)=int_K b_K |grad q|^2>0.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: A Taylor-Hood local pressure mode on a right triangle
items.statement: On K={(x,y):x>=0,y>=0,x+y<=1}, use q=x-1/3 and v=(x^2,0) to compute the local pairing b(v,q)=-1/18; this only detects a mode and proves no global stability claim.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: The alternating Q1/P0 checkerboard pressure defeats the discrete inf-sup condition
items.statement: On a 2x2 Cartesian square mesh, the alternating mean-zero cellwise-constant pressure annihilates every boundary-zero continuous Q1 velocity, so the discrete inf-sup constant is zero.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.

items.title: A weakly divergence-free mini velocity need not be pointwise divergence-free
items.statement: On the square split into two triangles, the mini velocity dimension exceeds the mean-zero continuous P1 pressure dimension; rank-nullity gives a nonzero weak-kernel velocity, while disjoint cell bubble supports force its divergence to be nonzero on at least one cell.
items.strategy: Complete local proof with the cited suppliers; the source ledger is evidence, not a substitute for proof.
